items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Davante Adams (leg), Ladd McConkey (concussion), Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned), Romeo Doubs (shoulder), Rashod Bateman (shoulder), Darnell Mooney (neck).
items.implication: Adams/McConkey status critical for remaining/ROS; Kincaid returned.
items.opportunity: If Adams limited, other LAR WRs; McConkey already out.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey ruled out with a concussion (evaluated mid-game for head injury).
items.implication: LAC WR targets shift; multi-week risk possible.
items.opportunity: Other Chargers WRs (e.g. Quentin Johnston) elevated snap/target share.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.implication: BUF WR targets redistribute to Palmer and others.
items.opportunity: Josh Palmer and remaining BUF WRs see increased target share.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.why: Injury designation; surprising given recent report status.
items.implication: TE streaming opportunity; Colts TE usage opens.
items.opportunity: Streamer TEs like Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth, Higbee elevated.

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle, previously GTD/questionable) is inactive/out for Week 6.
items.why: Ankle injury; practiced limited; pregame workout did not clear him.
items.implication: Browns backfield limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB opportunity in CLE backfield.

items.text: Actives include Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Rico Dowdle, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane.
items.implication: Full expected roles for CHI QB and NO skill players.
items.opportunity: Standard usage for Olave/Kamara; Dowdle opportunity.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings PS Tuesday).
items.why: Size/experience limits on remaining RBs; projections updated.
items.implication: Low-upside CLE RB committee; avoid or deep dart.
items.opportunity: Pure volume to McLaughlin/Estime but efficiency risk.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson and WR AJ Brown both officially active (previously likely).
items.why: Sources confirmed likely then official actives; NE near full health.
items.implication: NE offense at strength with Brown returning.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets for Brown; Henderson carries.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive surprising. Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
items.why: Warren out opens TE streamer spots.
items.implication: Stream Juwan et al. this week.

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today.
items.implication: Titans RB committee shift; potential carries if primary limited.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is out indefinitely.
items.implication: PHI QB situation long-term; backup starts.
items.opportunity: PHI skill players with new QB; Hurts stash.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Amid expected larger Najee Harris role.
items.why: Poor YOE + fumbles driving rotation change; Najee larger role expected, all 4 RBs active.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play.
Weekend summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf/Freiermuth/Sadiq; Not expected Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue.
items.implication: Monitor for final actives; many expected clear.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries if GTD out (e.g. CLE RBs, streamer TEs).

items.text: Updated ranks: Cam Skattebo at RB28, Najee Harris at RB33. Still start Skattebo but riskier flex post-rotation; prefer Najee over DK sometimes in PPR TD shot.
items.implication: Flex with caution; Najee viable alternative.

items.text: With Huntley back expect run-heavy BAL vs CLE; all-in Walker fresh off bye; no hotter RB than Jaylen Warren.
items.why: Script/matchup favors RBs; Walker rested, Warren hot.
